performance_case.causal_mechanism: Point-in-time active-buy pressure above the contemporaneous OKX book midline may contain information that persists beyond mechanical same-interval price impact into later 15- and 60-minute returns, but a single-venue signal may instead be contemporaneous impact or a reaction to cross-venue price discovery.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may assess only listed primary-source causal prior and alignment with already frozen V3 gates. It cannot access R2 outcomes, establish exact OKX predictive value, significance, PnL, drawdown, fees, fills, capacity, candidate readiness, OOS value, deployment readiness, or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: If later economic evidence shows that the frozen signal avoids adverse short-horizon paths rather than merely following contemporaneous impact, maximum drawdown may improve versus matched controls; this prior audit itself leaves drawdown MISSING_PROOF and has zero immediate drawdown effect.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A scope-correct prior can prevent waiting for the complete R2 evidence inventory only to discover that the proposed mechanism explains same-interval impact or another venue's price discovery. An over-strict prior could wrongly discard a useful forward association that the already frozen 14-day screen can test without new infrastructure.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Only if the already frozen V3 next-minute 15/60-minute screen later passes and its separate 30-bps matched-capital route also passes may order-flow pressure improve fee-adjusted total PnL. Literature support alone has zero immediate performance effect.
